name: What kind of permits do I need for a remodeling project in Berkeley?

mainEntity.name: What kind of permits do I need for a remodeling project in Berkeley?

acceptedAnswer.text: Remodeling projects in Berkeley typically require various permits depending on the scope of work. Minor cosmetic changes generally don't, but projects involving structural alterations, electrical work, plumbing, or significant changes to the building's footprint will necessitate permits from the City of Berkeley Planning and Development Department. For example, adding a new bathroom or reconfiguring walls will definitely require a permit. Frasheski Construction assists clients in navigating this process, identifying the specific permits needed to ensure all work complies with local building codes and regulations, which can prevent costly delays.
acceptedAnswer.description: In Berkeley, permits are required for most structural, electrical, or plumbing remodeling work; Frasheski Construction can help identify and secure them.
